---
title: "Practice exercises: ggplot2 basics and chart types"
---

The exercises below run in your browser and check your code automatically, giving you feedback as you go. Unlike the Data Analysis exercises, these are checked by comparing your **code** to a model solution rather than the result - so if the feedback doesn't say "correct", it'll point you to the specific part of your `aes()` or `geom_` call to fix. The last two are a bit more of a challenge - don't worry if you need a few tries.
